title: Sinner's Blood
writer: Lee Stone, Buddy Arett, Peter R.J. Deyell
actors: John Talt, Julie Conners, Cristy Beal
plot: A terrifying tale of an insane gang of bikers that wreaks havoc on a small town, where they mutilate, torture and create a reign of horror that's not to be believed. Not for the squeamish.
